question: Under what condition may a teacher bestow the life-giving teaching upon a disciple?
premises: The candidate must be thoroughly examined.
This examination should be done with constant care.
Only then may the teacher give what grants long life.
inference: A teacher should bestow the teaching that grants long life only after thoroughly examining the disciple.
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam is read metaphorically as a life-giving boon or teaching.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one who gives to him should grant long life.
